From: Jordan Thomas <jordan.thomas@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap - Redwood demo & security review

Thanks for the demo this morning, Marissa. Great overview - the latency/cost numbers you showed are compelling for our use case. A few quick notes from our side and next steps we discussed on the call:

- Primary use case: clinical-document summarization for our provider portal (PHI scope limited to patient identifiers).
- Key decision criteria: accuracy on clinical language, consistent latency under 300ms p50 for short responses, and clear data residency controls.
- Stakeholders we need involved: myself (product), Aisha Patel (Legal), and the procurement team for contracting/PO.

Action items for Redwood: send the security questionnaire (SOC2 + data handling), clarify which systems would be in scope for the review, and proposed timeline for kickoff. We can target a security kickoff the week of Mar 7 if that works.

Thanks - I can introduce procurement/legal in a follow-up thread once we have the questionnaire.

Jordan Thomas
Product Manager, Acme Health
jordan.thomas@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap - Redwood demo & security review

Jordan - thanks for the clear recap and for outlining the decision criteria. Appreciate the quick alignment. Looping in Rishi (security lead) and Sean (solutions) so we have the right folks on the kickoff.

Next steps from our side:
1) Attached: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf - standard intake covering SOC2, encryption, access controls, and data flow. If you can fill the initial sections and return, that will speed the kickoff.
2) Proposed kickoff agenda (30-45m): introductions, scope/PII definition, systems in scope, timelines & deliverables, evidence/API access plan, and questions.
3) Can you confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact so we can align contracting timeline and any required redlines?

Proposed times for kickoff: Tue Mar 8 10:00-10:45 PT or Wed Mar 9 13:00-13:45 PT. If those don't work, suggest alternatives.

Systems we expect to discuss during kickoff (prelim):
- Redwood-hosted inference endpoints (hosted API)
- VPC/dedicated deployment options (if you require private deployment)
- Data storage components: request logs, optional analytics DB (redwood-managed)
- Identity & access: SSO/SAML integration points, audit logs

If anything above is off, tell us and we'll adjust. Looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
